text: 2.24 Documents required for duplicate copy of freely transferable Authorisation Duplicate copy of freely transferable Authorisation may be issued against an application accompanied with following documents: (i) An application with fee equivalent to 10% of duty saved or duty credit (of unutilized balance). (ii) A copy of FIR reporting loss. (iii) Self- declaration to indemnify revenue loss, which may be caused on account of issue of such duplicate. 2.24 Documents required for duplicate copy of freely transferable Authorisation Duplicate copy of freely transferable Authorisation may be issued against an application accompanied with following documents: (i) An application with fee equivalent to 10% of duty saved or duty credit (of unutilized balance).
